title: SpeechMedAssist: Efficiently and Effectively Adapting Speech Language Models for Medical Consultation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing evaluation scores of multi-turn medical conversations across multiple different LLM judges (Qwen2.5-72B, LLaMA3-70B, DeepSeek-V3.1) to assess and mitigate the bias introduced by relying on a single fixed judge model.
